goal: Pre-decide routine engineering choices, bind ecosystem rules automatically, make version control deterministic, and hand those controls into generated product projects.

alignment.evidence: Work is isolated on athena/engineering-defaults-v0.4 and targets only the reusable harness and its generated-project handoff contract.
v0.3 contracts, WordPress Way, skill router, decision rights, old git-checkpoint.js, package scripts, generated scaffold, tests, and external harness references were inspected.
00-PLANNING/SYSTEM-MODEL.md confirms the low-question engineering-default, deterministic-VCS, and generated-project handoff model.
v0.4 does not create/delete remote repositories, force push, push managed work to main/master, merge, deploy, release, spend credits, or mutate production.

ENGINEERING-DEFAULTS.md owns routine defaults; ecosystem skills own platform rules; vcs-control.js owns Git operations; project-handoff.js copies proven controls into generated projects; project-control remains readiness/memory control.

The slice implements engineering defaults, deterministic skill binding, one consolidated WordPress contract, VCS control, safe generated-project handoff, and focused regression proof without a new orchestration framework.
The design reuses Node 20+ and existing controllers, adds no runtime dependency, refuses to overwrite project-customised handoff files, and marks the legacy interactive git helper unsupported.
PR #5 GitHub Actions run #14 passed on Node 20, 22, and 24. Each job passed npm test (including VCS and generated-project handoff regressions), npm run control:verify, and npm run memory:resume.
